subs.text: New sector, fresh start. Your accuracy resets in my heart, not in the ledger.
Outer Drift. Scouts ahead. Scout fire is light, and completely unprovoked.
That was close, and close is billable. Thank you for your proximity.
Streak! Your pay rate is climbing. So is my opinion of you. It was already high.
That hit was logged against the hull, not against you.
Personally, I think you're doing great.
Two hulls in a minute. You're fine! I'm starting to notice I say that a lot.
Your first live lock! Intel filed. Every scan helps the Authority map its lanes.
